title: JM Die Shop Data Ingestion & My Shop Population
description: Build the complete data ingestion pipeline to populate PRISM's My Shop app with real JM Die data: employees, prints, POs, invoices, RFQs, tooling, tool holders, vendors, brands, materials, and distribution network. Leverages existing engines (DocumentInboxEngine, EmployeeEngine, PurchaseOrderEngine, FileStorageEngine, ShopConfigurationEngine) and fills gaps (VendorEngine, ToolHolderCatalogEngine, FolderScannerEngine, DistributionNetworkEngine).

seed_domain_status.programs: in_progress — 10,216 files on H: drive, BoxProgramCensusEngine exists
seed_domain_status.employee_database: planned — EmployeeEngine exists, no JM Die data loaded
seed_domain_status.tooling: planned — ShopToolLibraryEngine exists, no JM Die inventory
seed_domain_status.materials: planned — MaterialRegistry exists, need JM Die stock list
seed_domain_status.prints: planned — BlueprintVisionOCREngine exists, no indexed prints

engines: DocumentInboxEngine (8 actions — ingest, batch, classify, match, search)
FileStorageEngine (7 actions — upload, versioning, SHA-256 dedup, attachments)
EmployeeEngine (create, skills, certifications, labor rates, department summary)
PurchaseOrderEngine (PO lifecycle, 3-way match, AP aging, receive hooks)
ShopConfigurationEngine (rates, machines, company profile, source roots, seed domains)
api_routes: shopProfile.ts (8 endpoints), inbox routes (8 endpoints), erp.ts (200+ endpoints)

milestones.title: Foundation: Folder Scanner & Ingestion Pipeline
milestones.description: Build the FolderScannerEngine that watches JM Die source_roots and feeds documents into DocumentInboxEngine. Create the ingestion orchestrator that routes files by type to the right engine. Create ShopProfilePage as the My Shop hub.
milestones.protocol: 4-LOOP per unit: BUILD -> SCRUTINIZE -> GAP FILL -> TIE UP

units.title: FolderScannerEngine — recursive directory scanner with change detection
units.description: Engine that scans ShopSourceRoots paths, detects new/changed files via mtime + SHA-256 hash comparison, and queues them for ingestion. Stores scan state in data/state/folder-scan-state.json. Supports file type classification (.MIN, .mcx-8, .pdf, .xlsx, .step, .dxf, .ipt, .sldprt). Does NOT use fs.watch (unreliable on network drives) — uses polling with configurable interval.
exit_criteria: Scanner finds all 10,216+ programs in JM Die/Programs
Change detection identifies new files without rescanning unchanged ones
File type classification is correct for all known extensions
Scan state persists across restarts

units.title: IngestionOrchestratorEngine — route files to domain-specific engines
units.description: Orchestrator that takes FolderScanner output and routes each file to the right processor: PDFs → DocumentInboxEngine, .MIN → BoxProgramCensusEngine (existing program parser), .mcx-8 → CadFileIndexEngine, .xlsx/.csv → SpreadsheetIngestionEngine, images → BlueprintVisionOCREngine. Tracks ingestion status per file. Supports batch mode and resume-after-failure.
exit_criteria: Routes PDFs to DocumentInboxEngine with correct classification
Routes .MIN files to program parser
Routes CAD files to CadFileIndexEngine
Tracks per-file ingestion status (pending/processing/complete/failed)
Resume capability after interruption

units.title: Create ShopProfilePage — prerequisite for all My Shop wiring
units.description: ShopProfilePage.tsx does not exist yet. Create it as the central 'My Shop' hub page showing company profile, machine list, rates, and seed domain status cards. Route at /shop. This page is modified by 5+ downstream units so it must exist first.
exit_criteria: ShopProfilePage.tsx renders at /shop route
Shows company name, machine count, rates summary
Shows seed_domain status cards from ShopConfigurationEngine
Links to EmployeeDirectoryPage, PurchaseOrdersPage, etc.

exit_criteria: prism_data:scan_folder action works via MCP
prism_data:ingest_batch processes a batch of files
/ingest skill triggers scan + ingestion

milestones.title: Employee Data Ingestion
milestones.description: Build the pipeline to ingest employee data from spreadsheets, PDFs, or manual entry into EmployeeEngine. Populate JM Die's employee roster with roles, certifications, machine authorizations, and labor rates.

units.title: SpreadsheetIngestionEngine — parse .xlsx/.csv employee data
units.description: Engine that reads employee spreadsheets (common HR export formats) and maps columns to EmployeeEngine fields: name, role, department, hire_date, hourly_rate, skills, certifications, machine_authorizations. Supports column auto-detection via header matching. Handles common formats: QuickBooks employee export, ADP export, generic CSV.
exit_criteria: Parses a sample JM Die employee spreadsheet
Auto-detects common column headers (Name, Role, Hire Date, Rate, etc.)
Maps to EmployeeEngine.create() input format
Handles missing/optional fields gracefully

units.title: Employee bulk import route + My Shop integration
units.description: Add /api/v1/erp/employee-import endpoint that accepts spreadsheet upload and uses SpreadsheetIngestionEngine to create employees in bulk. Update ShopProfilePage to show employee count and link to EmployeeDirectoryPage. Update seed_domains status to 'seeded' when employees are loaded.
exit_criteria: POST /api/v1/erp/employee-import accepts .xlsx and creates employees
ShopProfilePage shows employee count
seed_domains.employee_database status updates to 'seeded'
Duplicate detection by name+hire_date prevents re-import

milestones.title: Vendor & Distribution Network
milestones.description: Build VendorEngine for supplier master data and DistributionNetworkEngine to track where JM Die buys products. Populate from PO history, manual entry, and document ingestion.

units.title: VendorEngine — supplier master data with scorecards
units.description: Engine for vendor/supplier management: create, update, search, score. Fields: name, contact, terms (net30/net45/cod), categories (tooling/material/consumables/services), certifications, preferred_status, spend_ytd, on_time_pct, quality_pct, price_competitiveness. Links to PurchaseOrderEngine supplier_id. Methods: vendor_create, vendor_update, vendor_search, vendor_scorecard, vendor_spend_analysis, vendor_list_by_category.
exit_criteria: CRUD operations work for vendor master data
Scorecard calculates from PO history (on-time, quality, price)
Search by name, category, certification
Spend analysis by vendor over date range

units.title: DistributionNetworkEngine — where we buy what from whom
units.description: Engine tracking JM Die's supply chain: which vendors supply which product categories, brand preferences per category, pricing tiers, lead times. Maps product types to preferred vendors (e.g., 'carbide inserts' → 'MSC Industrial' / 'Kennametal direct'). Includes brand affinity tracking (which brands JM Die uses most). Methods: network_map, add_vendor_product, brand_preferences, supply_chain_risk, reorder_recommend.
exit_criteria: Maps product categories to vendor list with rankings
Brand preference tracking shows most-used brands per category
Supply chain risk flags single-source dependencies
Reorder recommendation includes preferred vendor + pricing

units.title: Wire vendors to MCP + dispatcher + My Shop UI
units.description: Add vendor actions to businessDispatcher. Create VendorManagementPage for web UI. Update ShopProfilePage with vendor count and top suppliers widget. Add /vendor skill.
exit_criteria: prism_business:vendor_create/search/scorecard actions work via MCP
VendorManagementPage shows vendor list with scorecards
ShopProfilePage shows vendor count + top suppliers
/vendor skill provides CLI access

forge_triple.hook: vendor-spend-alert — flags when vendor spend exceeds threshold or single-source risk

milestones.title: Print & Drawing Library
milestones.description: Build the print/drawing ingestion pipeline. Scan JM Die prints folder, OCR title blocks with BlueprintVisionOCREngine, index by part number/customer/revision, and link to programs and parts in PartsLibraryEngine.

units.title: PrintLibraryEngine — indexed drawing catalog with OCR extraction
units.description: Engine that manages engineering prints/drawings. Ingests PDFs and images from prints_root, runs BlueprintVisionOCREngine to extract title block (part number, revision, material, customer, date, tolerances). Indexes by part_number + revision for fast lookup. Links to PartsLibraryEngine parts. Methods: print_ingest, print_search, print_get, print_link_part, print_list_revisions, print_by_customer.
exit_criteria: Ingests PDF print and extracts title block via OCR
Indexes by part number + revision + customer
Links prints to PartsLibraryEngine parts
Search by part number, customer, material, date range
Handles multi-page drawings (assembly + detail sheets)

milestones.title: Tool Holders & Tooling Inventory
milestones.description: Build ToolHolderCatalogEngine for holder inventory (collets, chucks, boring bar holders, etc.) and enrich ShopToolLibraryEngine with JM Die's actual tooling inventory. Track brands, suppliers, and holder-to-machine compatibility.

units.title: ToolHolderCatalogEngine — holder inventory with machine compatibility
units.description: Engine for tool holder management. Fields: id, type (collet_chuck/hydraulic/shrink_fit/boring_bar_holder/end_mill_holder/ER_collet/shell_mill_arbor), brand, model, taper (BT40/CAT40/HSK-A63/MT3/MT4), bore_diameter_mm, gauge_length_mm, max_rpm, runout_um, machine_ids (compatible machines), quantity_on_hand, location. Methods: holder_create, holder_search, holder_get, holder_by_machine, holder_by_taper, holder_inventory_summary, holder_reorder_check. Includes common holder brands: Techniks, Lyndex-Nikken, Parlec, Big Daishowa, Rego-Fix, Maritool.
exit_criteria: CRUD for tool holders with all required fields
Search by taper, machine compatibility, type
Inventory tracking with reorder alerts

Machine compatibility matrix (which holders fit which machines)

milestones.title: PO / Invoice / RFQ Document Processing
milestones.description: Build the document processing pipeline that extracts structured data from PO, invoice, and RFQ documents (PDFs, scanned images) and populates PurchaseOrderEngine, VendorEngine, and quote pipeline automatically.

units.title: BusinessDocumentExtractorEngine — OCR + extraction for POs, invoices, RFQs
units.description: Engine that uses Claude Vision to extract structured data from business documents. PO extraction: vendor, PO number, line items (part, qty, unit price), ship-to, terms, date. Invoice extraction: invoice number, vendor, amount, due date, line items, tax. RFQ extraction: customer, part numbers, quantities, material spec, delivery date, tolerances. Routes extracted data to appropriate engine (PO → PurchaseOrderEngine, Invoice → InvoicingEngine, RFQ → QuoteEstimatorEngine). Links to DocumentInboxEngine for classification.
exit_criteria: Extracts PO fields from a scanned PO PDF with >90% accuracy
Extracts invoice fields from invoice PDF
Extracts RFQ requirements from customer RFQ
Auto-creates PO/invoice/quote records from extracted data
Links to vendor records via fuzzy name matching

When inbox receives a PO/invoice/RFQ PDF, auto-extract and create draft records pending approval. Add approval step before committing extracted data. Update InvoicesPage and PurchaseOrdersPage to show 'pending review' items from auto-extraction. Create /process-docs skill.
exit_criteria: Document inbox auto-classifies and extracts PO/invoice/RFQ documents
Extracted records appear as 'pending review' in respective pages

milestones.title: My Shop Dashboard — Unified Data Hub

units.title: ShopDataCompletenessEngine — score how populated the shop profile is
units.description: Engine that calculates a data completeness score for each seed_domain: programs (% scanned), employees (count vs expected), machines (specs completeness), controllers (post processors assigned), tool_holders (inventory loaded), tooling (tool crib populated), materials (stock list loaded), prints (prints indexed). Overall completeness percentage. Identifies gaps and recommends next ingestion action. Methods: completeness_score, domain_gaps, next_action_recommend.
exit_criteria: Calculates per-domain completeness percentage
Overall score reflects actual data population
Gap analysis identifies what's missing per domain
Recommends specific next action to improve completeness
Score updates as data is ingested

Add guided setup wizard that walks through each domain. Mobile-responsive layout.
exit_criteria: Completeness score displays prominently with per-domain breakdown
